name: l2cap_find_channel

ownership.argument: Borrowed per-cid channel for the Bluelet owner task only. Channel cid at +116; the list link is stored 8 bytes before the channel, the same 8-byte intrusive prefix the queue nodes use.

provenance.source: Walks the channel list at *(*(owner)) comparing an optional key against the channel word at +0 and the cid at +116, following the intrusive previous link at channel-8. Both call sites (0xC805CD8, 0xC805D26) are in the same public API cluster as the connect/disconnect wrappers.

notes: Borrowed per-cid channel for the Bluelet owner task only. Channel cid at +116; the list link is stored 8 bytes before the channel, the same 8-byte intrusive prefix the queue nodes use.
